_meta.description: Stage 5 (Expert) for the universal Anaplan product Sales journey template. Earn-once-then-maintain designation model — Expert sellers earn designation through contributive deliverables (deal narratives, client references, sales-playbook contributions, initial independent closed deals) and maintain it via ongoing selling + mentorship. Slots into the larger Sales template at stages[4].
structural_alignment_with_delivery: Same Model C structure: earn_set (required deliverables) → designation event → maintain_set (ongoing activities) → optional_set (recognized but not required)

Same six earn_set tasks mapped to sales-equivalents: deal narrative, client reference, sales-playbook contribution, initial independent closed deals, adjacent product overview review, adjacent product credentialing intent
Same maintain_set shape (2 tasks): ongoing independent deals + mentor a junior seller
Same optional_set shape: community contribution + Sales SME registration
Phase = 'expert' (matches Delivery's phase change from 'doing' to 'expert')
persona_specific_calls: Earn_set 'submit-customer-project-overview' (Delivery) → 'submit-deal-narrative' (Sales) — structured account of one closed-won deal: discovery, pitch, objections handled, competitive context, close mechanics. Becomes per-product knowledge asset.

Earn_set 'contribute-blueprint' (Delivery) → 'contribute-sales-playbook' (Sales) — per-product sales playbook covering value-framing patterns, objection-response patterns, competitive plays, industry-tailored pitches.

Earn_set 'complete-initial-independent-deliveries' (Delivery) → 'complete-initial-independent-closed-deals' (Sales) — 2 closed-won deals beyond the Stage 4 engagements, no senior-seller co-lead. Demonstrates self-sufficient selling.
Maintain_set 'lead-independent-deliveries-ongoing' (Delivery) → 'lead-ongoing-deals' (Sales) — continued selling activity expected of active Sales Experts.
Optional_set 'community-contribution' kept persona-broad — Sales contribution shapes are slightly different (case studies, conference speaking, thought leadership).
open_items_parked_for_later: Multi-product credentialing intent declaration — same parking-lot as Delivery (parent-journey work).
Expert maintenance review cadence — annual / on-demand / activity-driven. Program-level operational decision.
Loss of Expert status — what triggers it, what the recovery path is.
Per-product sales playbook review process — which CoE / sales enablement team owns reviewing and accepting playbook contributions.
Deal narrative standard — template/format for the structured deal-narrative document.
Client reference sponsorship process — operational integration with Anaplan customer reference programs (shared with Delivery).
User direction: 'your recommendations are fine for now and will be adjusted later after review' — this Stage 5 design is a starting point, expected to be refined.

_note: Stage 5 task structure is FIXED across all product journeys within the Sales persona. Adjacent product references are VARIABLE per product. Asset templates (deal narrative, sales playbook contribution) are fixed; specific contributions are per-Expert.
name: Expert
_terminal_outcome_example_ifp: Finance Sales Expert designation → FCR and Connected Planning Champion sales pathways
_designation_model_note: Model C — same as Delivery. Expert designation is EARNED by completing the earn_set tasks (contributive deliverables that convert individual selling experience into ecosystem value), then MAINTAINED by ongoing-state activities in the maintain_set. Optional_set tasks are recognized but not required for either earning or maintaining the designation.
description: Seller achieves and maintains Sales Expert designation for {{PRODUCT_NAME}} by contributing structured deliverables back to the ecosystem (deal narratives, client references, sales-playbook contributions) and maintaining ongoing practitioner activities (independent deals, mentorship). The Sales Expert is no longer just someone who can close deals — they are someone who actively shapes how others sell and which references customers see.

earn_set.description: Required contributive deliverables. All must be completed to achieve Sales Expert designation.

maintain_set.description: Ongoing activities expected of an active Sales Expert. Status maintenance reviewed on cadence (TBD).

optional_set.description: Recognized contributions that are not required for earning or maintaining Sales Expert designation.

tasks.title: Submit deal narrative
tasks.description: Produce a structured narrative of one closed-won {{PRODUCT_NAME}} deal — customer, deal scope, discovery findings, value-pitch construction, objections encountered and responses, competitive context, close mechanics, and what was learned. Becomes a per-product knowledge asset future sellers can learn from. Distinct from Stage 4 engagement artifacts (which were per-engagement advisory reviews) — this is a full deal story.
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM + sales enablement reviews the deal narrative against the standard format and accepts it as a per-product knowledge asset.
examples_of_good_output: Customer: Mid-market manufacturer (5,000 employees). Deal scope: IFP for 12 cost centers, 3-year contract. Discovery: surfaced existing budget-cycle pain costing 8 weeks per quarter. Pitch construction: tied IFP outcomes to CFO's stated quarterly-close target. Key objection: 'we already use Hyperion' — countered with Anaplan's connected-planning argument. Close: 9-week sales cycle, $X ACV.

Customer: Global retailer (40,000 employees). Deal scope: IFP for revenue planning across 6 regions. Discovery: surfaced regional-finance fragmentation and ROI gap. Competitive: head-to-head vs Workday Adaptive — won on multi-region scalability. Close: 6-month cycle, multi-year commit including FCR follow-on. Key learning: regional CFO endorsement was the decisive factor, not central-finance buy-in.

tasks.title: Sponsor a client reference
tasks.description: Sponsor at least one customer reference. Customer agrees to be referenced for the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} sale and deployment. Real signal — the customer is willing, the partner has the relationship, and the deal was successful enough to warrant referencing.
tasks.deliverable: Customer reference confirmation (customer-acknowledged willingness to be referenced)
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM confirms the reference is sponsored and integrated into Anaplan's customer reference program.
examples_of_good_output: Customer X agrees to participate in 1-2 prospect reference calls per quarter and to be named in case study materials. Reference scope: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} purchase decision, timeline, and outcomes specified.
Customer Y agrees to a video case study and conference speaking opportunity. Reference scope: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} multi-year roadmap including adjacent product expansion.

tasks.title: Contribute to {{PRODUCT_NAME}} sales playbook
tasks.description: Submit at least one accepted contribution to the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} sales playbook. Contributions can be drawn from Stage 4 artifact review feedback, deal narrative learnings, or independent observation. The Stage 4 engagement reviews and the deal narrative are likely raw material for playbook contribution.
examples_of_contribution_types: New value-framing pattern (e.g., 'tying {{PRODUCT_NAME}} to quarterly-close acceleration for CFOs')
New objection-response pattern (e.g., 'positioning vs. an entrenched Hyperion installation')
New competitive play (e.g., 'multi-region scalability talk-track vs. Workday Adaptive')
New industry-tailored pitch variant or case study addition
Edit to existing playbook section (e.g., 'expanded discovery questions for the data-readiness signal')
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: Sales enablement / playbook owner reviews and accepts the contribution.

tasks.title: Complete initial independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} closed deals
tasks.description: Close 2 independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} deals (no senior-seller co-lead, senior available on call only). These are closed-won deals beyond the 3 engagements from Stage 4. Demonstrates ability to sell without senior-seller scaffolding.
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM + senior seller (or sales coach) confirms the deals were independently led and closed-won.

tasks.title: Review {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} sales overview
tasks.description: Review {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} sales overview content to inform the credentialing intent declaration. Provides context for whether to pursue, defer, or decline the adjacent product Sales journey.

tasks.title: Declare {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} sales credentialing intent
tasks.description: After reviewing {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} sales overview, declare credentialing intent. Signal-only — does not start the adjacent journey, only captures the Sales Expert's intent for partner-firm and Anaplan planning.
tasks._multi_product_note: v0 captures one adjacent product. Multi-product credentialing intent (for parent-journey enrolees) is parking-lot for parent-journey work — same as Delivery.

tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Sales Expert designation
tasks.description: Formal recognition moment when the earn_set is complete. Issues Sales Expert credential, badge, and announces designation in partner community channels.
tasks.deliverable: Sales Expert credential issued; participant added to Sales Expert directory; community announcement
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: Triggered automatically when all earn_set tasks complete. No participant action required.

tasks.title: Lead ongoing independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} deals
tasks.description: Continue leading independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} sales activity to maintain active Sales Expert status. No fixed count — review on cadence (TBD) confirms continued practitioner activity.

tasks.title: Mentor a junior {{PRODUCT_NAME}} seller
tasks.description: Active mentorship of a junior seller progressing through the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Sales Journey. Requires named mentee and ongoing relationship.
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM acknowledges the mentee-mentor relationship and confirms ongoing activity. Mentee may be asked to attest to the relationship.

tasks.title: Community contribution
tasks.description: Recognized contributions to the partner community beyond the required earn_set deliverables.
examples: Polished case study (beyond the structured deal narrative)

tasks.title: Register as {{PRODUCT_SHORT}} Sales SME
tasks.description: Opt-in registry entry as a {{PRODUCT_SHORT}} Sales Subject Matter Expert. Discoverable in the Anaplan Sales SME directory; eligible for community speaking opportunities, strategic-deal advisory queries, and partner-firm staffing queries.

gates.description: Deal narrative submitted and accepted by PSM + sales enablement (≥1)
Client reference sponsored and integrated into Anaplan reference program (≥1)
≥2 initial independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} closed-won deals confirmed by PSM + senior seller
{{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} sales credentialing intent declared (pursue / defer / decline)
Sales Expert designation issued — earn_set complete, credential and badge issued, community announcement made
Active Sales Expert continues leading independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} deals
Active mentee-mentor relationship logged with named junior seller

estimated_effort_total: Variable — earn_set typically achieved 6-18 months after Stage 4 completion depending on deal velocity and contribution opportunities. Maintain_set is ongoing.
_estimated_effort_total_note: Stage 5 is bound by real deal availability, playbook contribution opportunities, and customer reference relationships — not participant work hours.

_per_product_authoring_obligations.description: Stage 5 has minimal per-product asset authoring. Per-product obligations are review and acceptance processes.

items.scope: Template/format for the structured deal-narrative document. Same template across products preferred.
Per-product sales-enablement / playbook owner identified and review process defined.
Identify the correct {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} and {{ADJACENT_JOURNEY_ID}} for each Sales journey.

items: Expert maintenance review cadence — when and how Sales Expert status is re-confirmed against the maintain_set.
Sales playbook contribution review SLA — time from contribution submission to acceptance.
Client reference sponsorship coordination — Anaplan customer reference programs may have their own gates and processes (shared with Delivery Stage 5).
Mentee pool — Stage 5 mentorship requires a junior seller available to mentor.
Multi-product Sales Experts — under parent journeys, an Expert may hold designation for IFP + FCR + AI simultaneously.
